content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Conventional payment platforms often impose high fees and stringent requirements that exclude many digital creators. For example, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This significant difference means that if you sell 100 ebooks priced at $97 each, you retain $921 more by using our infrastructure. Our model eliminates dependency on these platforms, allowing for complete ownership of your sales process.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin, you need a few key components. First, set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for free hosting. Next, prepare a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. You should also have a NOWPayments account ready for handling bitcoin transactions and an understanding of Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automating your backend processes. Gather your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates, to load into your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, integrate NOWPayments with your chosen platform. Set up a webhook to trigger product deliveries automatically upon payment confirmation. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage order storage and automate the workflow. By linking your digital products stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, your customers will receive immediate access upon successful payment, streamlining the entire purchasing experience.
By using NOWPayments, you keep more of your earnings.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it’s time to go live. Share your store link with your audience, promoting your ebooks and digital products. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure everything functions as intended. With the NOWPayments integration, cryptocurrency payments should process automatically, providing you with instant notifications of new sales. This setup not only enhances customer experience but also gives you confidence in your ability to operate independently of traditional payment processors.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial launch, focus on scaling your operations. Use insights from your early sales to optimize your product offerings and marketing strategies. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you gain access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates that can help you expand your store's capabilities. Continuously refine your backend processes with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle increased traffic and sales effortlessly while maintaining a seamless user experience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, establish a sovereign digital commerce stack using tools like NOWPayments for payment processing and Google Drive for file delivery. This setup ensures you retain ownership and control without relying on traditional platforms. It empowers you to process transactions efficiently and keep more of your revenue.
Automated delivery means less hassle and happier customers.

If you're looking to sell ebooks and digital products without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH. This comprehensive package provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Discover it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

To set up automatic product delivery, integrate NOWPayments with your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This setup ensures that customers receive their products instantly upon successful payment confirmation.
